purpose: Teach: 給油/特許庁/細分/折り返し/見込ん/配合/多角/個展

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社用車の給油、月々の経費、本気で、見直していけ、絶対、効率化、急務だ。
lines.en: The company car fuel expenses—monthly costs need a serious review. Cutting waste and improving efficiency is urgent, non-negotiable.
lines.style: Clipped, direct delivery. Each phrase lands with weight. No softening—this is a mandate, not a suggestion. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。特許庁、新規申請、本気で、進めてまいります、絶対、お得意様の信頼、感謝。
lines.en: Understood. We're pushing forward with the Patent Office applications with full commitment. Our valued clients deserve nothing but our best effort.
lines.style: Respectful but assured. Clean, deliberate pacing. Each commitment stated plainly without hedging. Quiet confidence underlying the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業務、細分化して、効率、本気で、上げていけ、絶対、若手、活躍させろ、本気で、頼んだ。
lines.en: Break down the work into smaller units. Drive up efficiency—seriously. Get the junior staff out there making a real impact. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Emphatic but not harsh. The repeated instruction signals this matters. Slight lean forward on the key demands. Expects buy-in, not resistance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様、折り返しのお電話、本気で、絶対、すぐに、対応するよう、徹底中です、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We're ensuring all client callbacks are handled immediately. We've made this a priority across the team—it's being done.
lines.style: Factual, reassuring. No apology in the tone, just proof of execution. Steady delivery showing this isn't aspirational—it's already happening.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手、本気で、見込んで、配属、進めろ、絶対、人材育成、急務だ、本気で、頼んだぞ。
lines.en: Junior staff development is critical. I want you moving forward with assignments for the promising ones. Building talent is urgent. I'm relying on you.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. The seriousness of talent development comes through. Slight pause before 'I'm relying on you'—personal accountability.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の配合、研究室、本気で、改良中です、絶対、お客様、ご満足、いただけるはず。
lines.en: We're in the middle of refining the new product formula in the lab right now. Our customers will definitely be satisfied with the results.
lines.style: Steady, factual update. Confidence in the work without boasting. Slight warmth on the guarantee—this is something he genuinely believes in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、多角的に、見る視点、社員、本気で、養え、絶対、視野、広い人材、目指せ、絶対。
lines.en: Staff need to learn how to see their industry from every angle. Develop broader perspective. That's what I'm building toward—people who can think wide.
lines.style: Reflective but directive. This isn't just an instruction—it's an ideal being articulated. Slight pedagogical tone, like teaching a principle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の個展、来月、開催予定です、社員、皆、本気で、楽しみにしております、本当に。
lines.en: The founder's solo exhibition opens next month. The whole team is genuinely looking forward to it. It means a lot to everyone here.
lines.style: Warmth emerging naturally. The shift is palpable—he's speaking of something personal now, not just operational. Genuine pleasure beneath the formality.
